# 111network Knowledge Base

> The curated, AI-readable knowledge base every layer of the OS reads from.
> It catalogs external projects, device profiles, protocols, models, recipes, and concepts, each graded candidate, testing, or proven by the three-gate rubric.
> It powers the adopt-vs-build rule: if a solid project exists, we use it.

1. Statuses: `proven` = verified in our own field log, `testing` = passing our smoke test, `candidate` = desk research only; the tally below counts them — until proven entries exist, the full catalog lives under Optional — read it first.
2. Each line is `- [title](path): summary | status | tag1,tag2,tag3` — the summary is the entry's one-line verdict; open the file for the full entry.
3. This index is generated by `_meta/build.py` and never hand-edited; every category folder carries its own `llms.txt` with the same shape, and hold entries appear only there, marked `| hold`.

## Optional

- [Automerge](projects/automerge.md): Local-first CRDT library for JSON documents with Git-like merge history. | candidate | crdt,offline,storage
- [bc-sskr](projects/bc-sskr.md): Audited C Shamir key sharing that round-trips with BIP-39 mnemonics. | candidate | identity,offline
- [BIP-39](protocols/bip-39.md): Mnemonic seed-phrase standard; checksum is weak and format carries no version. | candidate | identity,offline
- [Briar Bramble](projects/briar-bramble.md): Offline-first messaging protocol family with strong introduction patterns. | candidate | identity,mesh,offline
- [curve25519-dalek](projects/curve25519-dalek.md): Rust Curve25519 group arithmetic behind the dalek signing and ECDH crates. | candidate | identity,offline
- [ed25519-dalek](projects/ed25519-dalek.md): Rust Ed25519 library; Quarkslab audit was marginal and predates v2. | candidate | identity,offline
- [EDHOC](protocols/edhoc.md): Lightweight authenticated key exchange for constrained links; young ecosystem. | candidate | identity,networking,offline

- [Iroh NodeId](projects/iroh-nodeid.md): Raw-Ed25519-pubkey NodeId proven at 200M-plus endpoints on public relays. | candidate | identity,networking
- [libsodium](projects/libsodium.md): Portable C crypto library; no comprehensive audit, parity and reference role only. | candidate | identity,networking,offline
- [llama.cpp](projects/llama-cpp.md): Low-level portable C/C++ GGUF inference engine for CPU-first local inference. | candidate | llm,offline,runtime
- [MeshCore](projects/meshcore.md): LoRa mesh whose Ed25519 pubkey-as-identity proves our Cat 1 shape. | candidate | identity,lora,mesh
- [Meshtastic](projects/meshtastic.md): LoRa mesh firmware using managed flooding; flooding scales poorly on busy channels. | candidate | lora,mesh
- [Meshtastic PKI](projects/meshtastic-pki.md): Meshtastic identity layer; its 2025 CVE cascade is our cautionary test plan. | candidate | identity,lora,mesh
- [Monocypher](projects/monocypher.md): Audited compact C crypto for Cat 1; single maintainer, CC0 forkability recorded. | testing | hardware,identity,offline
- [Noise Protocol Framework](protocols/noise-framework.md): Pattern-based handshake framework; patterns verified, implementations unaudited. | candidate | identity,networking,offline
- [Nostr](protocols/nostr.md): Signed-event protocol with self-authenticating identity and offline-first relay sync. | candidate | identity,networking,sync
- [OpenCode](projects/opencode.md): Open-source coding agent CLI with terminal TUI and 75+ model providers. | candidate | agent,llm
- [Qwen3 4B](models/qwen3-4b.md): Apache-2.0 4B-parameter LLM family default for local reasoning, coding, and agents. | candidate | llm,offline
- [Reticulum](projects/reticulum.md): Sovereign end-to-end encrypted networking stack; custom license needs legal review | candidate | mesh,networking,offline
- [Reticulum protocol](protocols/reticulum-protocol.md): Public-domain mesh protocol design; code license non-OSI with AI-training clause. | candidate | identity,mesh,networking
- [SLIP-0010](protocols/slip-0010.md): Hardened-only Ed25519 HD derivation standard that pairs with BIP-39 seeds. | candidate | identity,offline
